description: This file defines a repository interface for performing data access operations related to the 'Grade' entity within a Spring Data JPA context. It includes a custom query method to find a Grade by its associated submission ID.

classes.name: GradeRepository
classes.description: A repository interface extending JpaRepository for performing CRUD operations on 'Grade' entities, with an additional method to find a grade by submission ID.

methods.name: findBySubmissionId
methods.description: A custom method to retrieve a Grade entity based on the submission ID, returning an Optional to handle the case where no matching record is found.
